title: Power-law violations of Yau's nodal upper bound

abstractEnglish: We construct a smooth Riemannian metric on $`S^4\times S^1`$ and a sequence of real Laplace eigenfunctions whose nodal four-volume grows faster than $`\lambda^{1/2+\epsilon_0}`$ for one fixed $`\epsilon_0\gt 0`$. This disproves the smooth upper-bound assertion in Yau's nodal-set conjecture and the proposed bound with an arbitrarily small positive power loss.
